title: Influencing the activity of somatic comorbidities through trauma-centered psychotherapy with EMDR using autoimmune thyroiditis Hashimoto, chronic polyarthritis, and inflammatory bowel disease as examples
summary: The aim of the study is to investigate whether psychotherapy using Eye Moevement Desensitization and Reprocessing (EMDR), which is aimed at dealing with trauma, leads to an improvement in autoimmune disorders, which occur more frequently in patients with complex post-traumatic stress disorders. In a randomized study, patients will either receive standard treatment or psychotherapy with EMDR in addition to standard treatment.

interventions.name: Eye Movement Densensitization and Reprocessing (EMDR) + treatment as usual

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
complex posttraumatic disorder, 
indication for EMDR therapy
ATH, CED, RA
Exclusion criteria:
Lack of stability and real-life conflicts in the present  
suicidal patients  
Patients with acute substance dependence and a schizophrenic disorder or psychotic depression
Exclusion criteria for an MRI examination
Pregnancy
